claims.text: Data/migration additive + reversible (forward): a SQLite checkpoint written by the real previous release (source at cba9dba, run in a child interpreter that asserts it imported the old cma package) stores Transactions with only the 7 old fields, and this release's `cma resume` approves it and writes an evidence record with schema_version 1. This answers the attempt-1 major finding (simulated old payload).

Rollback path (reinstall previous release) tried: the old release's own Transaction model loads a line written by this one and drops the three new fields (test_the_previous_release_loads_a_transaction_this_one_writes, above). CMA_RULESET is not introduced by T02, so this reinstall is T02's rollback path.

Observability: schema_version in every evidence record is the signal that the new writer ran, keyed to the statement sha256 already in the record. Remote alerting is not applicable by design (design.md Observability: no remote alerting, the tool refuses with a non-zero exit). T02 adds no new failure mode that needs an alert.

dispositions.evidence: On HEAD b24844c, tests/test_previous_release.py::test_a_checkpoint_written_by_the_previous_release_resumes runs `cma run` from the git-archived source at cba9dba in a child interpreter. The guard asserts cma.__file__ is under the extracted tree, so the old package really ran. The test checks that every stored Transaction has exactly the 7 old fields, then resumes and approves under this release. test_all_extras_are_installed imports anthropic and openai (the llm extra), mcp and the sqlite checkpointer. Both PASSED in `python -m pytest -q -m contracts -rA`.

notes: No code changes in this hardening pass; HEAD b24844c already contains the evidence. Gaps for the owner: (1) The repo has no changelog, so the README paragraph is the only release note. Add a CHANGELOG line if one is wanted. (2) `ruff check .` from the repo root reports 14 errors, all in committed .bridgie/runs/statement-review/implementer-02 and implementer-05 helper scripts. They predate T02 and are outside its scope, but the runner should lint src/tests/evals or those files should be removed from the branch. (3) tests/previous_release.py pins BASE=cba9dba and needs git history, so it fails in a shallow clone without that commit. (4) Rollback by flag (CMA_RULESET) arrives with C1/T-later, not T02. T02's rollback is reinstalling the previous release, proven above.
